locationComparison.name: Ghost spawns (various)
notes: Ghosts are spread across ~20 low-density spots (e.g. Catacombs of Kourend, Crumbling Tower, Taverley Dungeon, Wilderness graveyards); this dataset uses one generic catch-all row instead of per-location rows.

Cannonability varies by spot per the wiki task table: cannon-prohibited at Catacombs of Kourend and Revenant Caves, but permitted at most other ghost spots; multicombat and safespot also vary. The all-false booleans here are a conservative placeholder, not a per-spot verification.
Ghosts drop nothing at most locations, so they are rarely trained; this is a starter Slayer-XP task.

taskNotes: Ghosts require combat level 13 to be assigned by Turael, Spria, or Mazchna; there is no Slayer level or quest requirement for the base task.
slayerTargetId 289 is SYNTHETIC (c2-c3-worklist section 1 allocation contract); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
The standard level-19 Ghost has 25 Hitpoints, max hit 2 (crush melee), 4-tick attack speed, and Defence level 18.
Ghosts are undead and spectral: the salve amulet and Crumble Undead both apply.
Ghosts have a 50% elemental weakness to air spells (magic defence -5).
Higher-level Ghost variants (levels 25, 76/77) exist in the Sepulchre of Death; the level-25 variant gives 75 Slayer XP but its combat stats are honest-UNKNOWN.
No required protective item and no task extension unlock exist for Ghosts.
All currently modelled revenant forms count for Ghosts tasks. Their Wilderness location and dedicated encounter requirements apply even when the assignment comes from a starter master.
recommendedMethod: A low-level Slayer-XP task: kill the level-19 Ghosts with any melee weapon, or cast air spells to exploit the 50% elemental weakness. A salve amulet gives an undead damage bonus. Ghosts drop nothing at most spots, so they are done for the Slayer XP and task streak rather than loot.
